usage: Kartu preview tema Sagara. Ditampilkan di hero section landing page sebagai showcase utama. Harus langsung menampilkan dunia Sagara: laut malam 2.5D, kapal besar, dan suasana petualangan.
prompt: Ultra-cinematic 2.5D parallax diorama scene of an anime pirate ocean at night. Deep midnight navy ocean landscape, multiple depth layers visible simultaneously creating a 2.5D parallax depth effect. Layer 1 (sky/far background): deep dark indigo-navy sky #070C18 to #0A1628, scattered glowing stars, 3-4 soft cream-white clouds drifting at different heights, warm and hazy. Layer 2 (far horizon): 2-3 small tropical islands silhouette in cool blue-violet mist on the horizon, barely visible, atmospheric haze. Layer 3 (mid ocean): wide dark teal ocean surface #0E2A3A, glowing phosphorescent cyan foam patterns at wave crests, luminous bioluminescent particles in water. Layer 4 (main ship): massive ornate wooden pirate sailing ship center-right, warm amber lanterns glowing on hull and masts, large cream-white billowing sails with golden trim, a Jolly Roger flag at top mast, visible detailed wooden planks, warm light spilling from portholes. Ship is majestic, heroic, slightly tilted left sailing into frame. Layer 5 (foreground): partial view of a gigantic dark whale breaching bottom-left, deep blue whale with white belly, spectacular foam splash, scale dwarfing the ship. 2 white seagulls mid-flight. Overall: breathtaking anime painterly illustration style, highly detailed, cinematic depth-of-field, warm amber and cold teal color contrast, phosphorescent ocean glow, dramatic scale and atmosphere, ultra high quality, 16:9 widescreen composition.
negative_prompt: UI elements, text, watermark, white background, flat design, cartoon, simple, generic, low quality, daytime scene (must be night/dusk), realistic photography style
notes: Ini adalah kartu showcase tema SAGARA — tema portofolio bertema pelayaran One Piece dengan parallax 2.5D 7 layer. Preview-nya harus mencerminkan kekayaan visual itu: laut dalam, kapal epik, paus raksasa, atmosfer malam yang indah. Warna dominan: midnight navy, teal phosphorescent, amber warm. JANGAN ada UI chrome atau frame device.
